AskEventData.description:
Data shape of the `ask` SSE event — the agent pauses a turn to ask the
user a clarifying question (e.g. which side of the contract they are).
AskEventData.title: AskEventData

AttachLibraryRequest.description:
Attach an existing library document to a conversation; session_id=None
creates a new conversation (mirrors the upload flow).
AttachLibraryRequest.title: AttachLibraryRequest

DocumentReadyEventData.description:
Data shape of the `document_ready` SSE event (E20): готовый .docx
сохранён в библиотеку «Файлы» и привязан к беседе. Тот же payload — на
сообщении (`MessageOut.template_doc`).
DocumentReadyEventData.title: DocumentReadyEventData

MessageAsk.description:
Persisted shape of a paused-for-input turn, stored on the message and
replayed via `GET /conversations/{id}/messages` (`MessageOut.ask`).
MessageAsk.title: MessageAsk

ProfileUpdateRequest.description:
Partial profile update: only the fields present in the request body
are applied (`exclude_unset` semantics in the route). `onboarded: true`
and `tour_completed: true` stamp their timestamps once — repeats are
idempotent.
ProfileUpdateRequest.title: ProfileUpdateRequest

ResetDeltaEventData.description:
Empty payload — the event name carries all the meaning.

Signals the frontend to discard any draft `delta` text accumulated this
turn. The backend emits this when the LLM streamed visible text and then
asked for a tool call; the text was not the final answer.
ResetDeltaEventData.title: ResetDeltaEventData

TemplateDraftEventData.description:
Data shape of the `template_draft` SSE event (E20): панель сводки
staged-черновика. Тот же payload хранится на сообщении
(`MessageOut.template_draft`) — панель переживает перезагрузку истории.
TemplateDraftEventData.title: TemplateDraftEventData

UploadResponse.description:
Agent upload-proxy response: the hub document plus the conversation it
was attached to (the frontend needs session_id for newly created chats).
UploadResponse.title: UploadResponse

post.description:
Кооперативная остановка текущего хода. Идемпотентен: 204 и когда
ход уже завершился. 404 — чужая или несуществующая беседа (наружу не
различаем).

Attach an existing library document to a conversation (created when
session_id is empty) — the «спросить по выбранным» flow of the Files screen.

get.description:
Скачивание отчёта файлом (T-0049). Пока единственный формат — DOCX;
PDF отдаёт фронт печатью панели (решение плана T-0049).
